svg.title: Learning
svg.desc: Everything that can happen to an event. Learning stages it in two parts, working memory and then long-term memory; a person then checks every change to both, including the second- and third-order ripple, and only what they approve is committed. Inference reads committed versions and never writes.
svg.text: Everything that can happen to an event. Learning stages it in two parts, working memory and then long-term memory; a person then checks every change to both,
including the second- and third-order ripple, and only what they approve is committed. Inference reads committed versions and never writes.
